summary: An incoming member learns who will swear them in and what office that person holds.
realLife: In January 2025 Harold Rogers of Kentucky administered the oath to Mike Johnson as dean of the House. Johnson then swore in the other representatives as Speaker.
inGame: needs: confirm the selected role is available in narration. swearing-in.ts selects the counterpart.
gates: This is the member’s first meeting with the oath giver.

turns.what: The clerk names the officer for the gallery while the incoming member greets them by name.
turns.pulledBy: The two have served together before.
turns.writesBack: The introduction informs the audience and preserves the existing acquaintance.

turns.what: The member’s child picks out the dean as the person who will swear in her parent, having just watched him give the Speaker the oath.
turns.pulledBy: The family watched the Speaker’s ceremony and is still in the gallery for the members’ ceremony.
turns.writesBack: The parent explains the change of roles and the family’s account identifies the Speaker as the official who swore in the parent.
